decisions.reason: Launched only in 2023, the electronic music box's seasonal demand has not yet shown its value. Keeping a catalog item listed on the website costs little, so the option stays open for another Christmas season.
A wooden nativity stable fits the firm's core Erzgebirge-style woodcraft and serves stable recurring seasonal demand. It is a low-cost, low-risk option worth keeping while results accumulate.

The modern incense smoker tests a new design direction whose market reception remains uncertain after one season. Since production and listing costs are small, management keeps it until more sales evidence arrives.
